$comment: Feature groups for README › Features. Add a capability here in the same PR that ships it; link the document that owns its detail. Edit, then `npm run docs:write`.

groups.title: Trading workspace
items: Dashboard, accounts, balances and challenge progress
Request-based 14-day Free Trial (One-phase or Two-phase) with trial and phase-pass certificates
Market, limit and stop orders with risk preview
Chart protection: SL/TP handles and P/L zones
Collateral, quantity and lot sizing conventions
Funding and Details tabs with our own hourly funding history
Terminal guide with recorded walkthroughs

groups.title: Journal and analytics
items: Daily journal, notebook, playbooks and missed trades
Net PnL, win rate, profit factor, drawdown
Edge Score v2 and calendar performance
Account-scoped notes with safe import

groups.title: Charts and Pine indicators
items: Vela charts with the official Pine addon
Open Algo V5, Price Action Concepts, Smart Money Concepts
Original Pine sources run in a worker
Settings scoped by product and wallet

groups.title: Hybrid Footprint
items: Bid/ask ladder and profiles
Volume and delta profiles, absolute delta
POC, value area and imbalances
Gains candles stay unchanged

groups.title: Trade Radar
items: Live large-trade tape from $10K to $1M
Leaderboards and long/short positioning
Whale positions and wallet profiles
Stale data is marked, never hidden

groups.title: Market Heatmap
items: Area by 24h volume or open interest
Color by 24h change or hourly funding
Drill-down, search and proportional +N tiles
Jump from a tile into the chart

groups.title: Tools Center
items: Position size, leverage/margin, liquidation
Perp PnL, funding rate, risk/reward
Risk of ruin, prop drawdown, consistency rule
Journal analyzer in the browser

groups.title: Learning center

Searchable glossary
FAQ hub, rulebook and whitepaper
Tools link to the matching lessons

items: Sign-In with Ethereum on Arbitrum One
Explicit wallet picker over every page, keyboard and phone friendly
Mobile wallets by QR code through WalletConnect (Reown)
Server-side HttpOnly sessions, every record scoped to its owner

groups.title: On-chain records
items: Soulbound certificate NFTs: purchase, Free Trial start, phase pass, final pass, payout
Every position open, SL/TP change, partial close and close recorded publicly
Arbitrum Sepolia; Openfund pays, traders never sign
Transactional outbox with idempotent, retried sends
Public Smart contracts page: addresses, Arbiscan links, source and audit status

groups.title: Payments
items: Pay with Wallet and manual transfer
On-chain verification of token, amount and finality
Ledger with partial payments and refunds
Exactly-once challenge activation

Animated Airdrop and Smart contracts pages in the Challenges and Resources menus

Five locales with right-to-left layouts, light and dark themes

Persian and Arabic normalization, typo tolerance and synonyms
Published content only, one index per region
Anonymous search analytics in Backstage

items: Proof of payouts reviewed with KYC
Single-use pass: normal price, funded-stage start
Private, encrypted evidence storage with retention
Editable firm list and rules

groups.title: Openfund Premium League

Email-verified registration, one entry per wallet
Frozen standings, owner-gated awards and review signals
Original prize artwork and rank badges

groups.title: Trading objectives
items: Every objective with the real numbers of each plan and size

Wallet-signed funded-trader agreement
Worked pass and fail scenarios

groups.title: Labs drops

Archive with the real number sold

items: Final-pass review and suspension decisions
Payment investigation, coupons, payouts
Partners, finance, risk board and audit
Owner re-authentication for privileged actions
Bug bounty rewards and a consent-only hall of fame

items: Directus owns public editorial copy
Visual editing mapped to collection and field
